title: Normalized coefficient-system scalar and projection presentation
statement: Let $f$ be a ringed-topos morphism [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism] on sites small in the coefficient universe [def-weil-size-convention]. Use module-sheaf categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], their ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and internal module objects [det-def-sfb-module-objects-definition]. Fix the ambient strict reduction models [lem-weil-pbc-reduction-pullback-derived-tower]. Use the strict coefficient-system category and normalized scalar models of [def-sfb-quotient-system-scalar-data]. Let $f^*$ be an exact inverse-image module functor with its specified strong monoidal presentation and canonical tensor comparison $k$, put $Q_X=f^*Q_Y$, and fix scalar models $\mathcal B_Y,\mathcal B_X$ over the ambient reduction models. Fix the normalized ambient derived direct images $G,G^{Tow}$ and adjunctions [lem-weil-pbc-augmented-diagram-projection-mate]. A coefficient projection presentation consists of an ordinary coefficient-linear isomorphism $f_Q^*\circ s_{Q_Y}\cong s_{Q_X}\circ f^*$, a derived isomorphism $F_Q\mathcal B_Y\cong\mathcal B_XF$, a right adjoint $G_Q$ of the actual exact module-object pullback $F_Q$, and an isomorphism $d:U_YG_Q\cong G^{Tow}U_X$. It is normalized when the ordinary comparison at every level is $k_{Q_n,M}$ on underlying left-module free objects, the derived comparison is its conjugation by the universal scalar counits on every flat-term K-flat representative, and $d$ satisfies $\varepsilon_{Tow}F^{Tow}(d_N)=U_X(\varepsilon_{Q,N})a_{G_QN}$, where $a:F^{Tow}U_Y\cong U_XF_Q$ is the localization of the ordinary restriction/pullback equality. No existence assertion is part of this definition.
